summary: The southern piece of the Port's 20th/Illinois Street parcel, on Illinois Street south of the new 21st Street, reserved under the 2017 approvals as a 100%-affordable housing site (65 ft under the D4D). The Port's 2026 report assigns it to Phase 2 and says its gap funding is not yet available; no developer has been selected.

milestones.text: Port Commission approves subdividing the 20th/Illinois parcel into the Plaza Parcel, Parcel K North, the 21st Street right-of-way extension and Parcel K South, with PKS 'developed as an affordable housing site' (Resolution 17-52 recitals)
Board of Supervisors public hearing on forming Infrastructure and Revitalization Financing District No. 2 (Hoedown Yard) to finance affordable housing within Pier 70 and Parcel K South
Port reports Parcel K South as the Phase 2 affordable site; the developer is responsible for horizontal improvements to it under the DDA; gap-funding sources 'currently unavailable'

Completion expected by Phase 2's DDA outside date; this stand-alone affordable parcel is now grouped in subphase 2B of the Port's proposed 2026 phasing plan, though its gap funding is not yet available
milestones.basis_note: Phase 2 has a DDA Schedule of Performance outside date of approximately 16 years after the 2017 Project approval, about 2033 (Port Commission Item 9B, Sept 22, 2017, Table A, p.7); not a parcel-specific date, and Phase 1, which precedes it in the sequence, remains stalled per the Port's August 2026 report.

milestones.text: Port Commission Resolution 17-52 approves subdividing the 20th/Illinois parcel to create Parcel K South as a stand-alone site to be 'developed as an affordable housing site'; this action is specific to Parcel K South and separate from FC Pier 70's 28-Acre Project DDA, which does not cover it

facts.value: 100% affordable housing (one of three stand-alone affordable parcels with C1B and C2A)
Port of San Francisco (Port-controlled parcel outside the developer's option)
no more than six residential stories (D4D S6.4.2)
Phase 2 (affordable) / Phase 2B in Exhibit A, with C1 (Port's 2026 report)

The 2017 Affordable Housing Plan requires at least 30% of units at the 28-Acre Site and Parcel K South be affordable, including 320 or more permanently affordable units in three buildings developed by local nonprofits; the 2026 proposal keeps a 327-unit stand-alone minimum while lowering the project-wide rate to no less than 20%
The D4D lets the Retail and Service frontage for HDY3 and HDY1/2 be combined on 22nd Street; Irish Hill Corner Plaza sits at the PKS/HDY3 corner of Illinois and 22nd
